mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_EXPENSE ( USER_ID, USER_CARD_ID, CATEGORY_ID, MERCHANT_NAME, AMOUNT, PAYMENT_DATE, INPUT_TYPE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userCardId}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, NOW(), 'PAYMENT' )

INSERT INTO TBL_MOCK_PAYMENT ( USER_ID, USER_CARD_ID, EXPENSE_ID, MERCHANT_ID, MERCHANT_NAME, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, REQUESTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userCardId}, #{expenseId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantName}, #{paymentAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT pw.POINT_WALLET_ID AS pointWalletId, pw.POINT_PROVIDER_ID AS pointProviderId, pp.POINT_PROVIDER_NAME AS providerName, pw.TOTAL_POINT AS totalPoint FROM TBL_POINT_WALLET pw JOIN TBL_POINT_PROVIDER pp ON pw.POINT_PROVIDER_ID = pp.POINT_PROVIDER_ID WHERE pw.USER_ID = #{userId} AND pp.USE_YN = 'Y' AND pp.POINT_PROVIDER_TYPE = 'FINANCIAL_POINT' ORDER BY pw.TOTAL_POINT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_POINT_WALLET SET TOTAL_POINT = TOTAL_POINT + #{savedPoint}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE POINT_WALLET_ID = #{pointWalletId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, POINT_WALLET_ID, EXPENSE_ID, POINT_TYPE, POINT_AMOUNT, CONTENT, OCCURRED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pointWalletId}, #{expenseId}, 'SAVE', #{savedPoint}, #{content}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT p.payment_id AS paymentId, p.expense_id AS expenseId, cd.card_name AS cardName, p.merchant_name AS merchantName, p.payment_amount AS paymentAmount, p.payment_status AS paymentStatus, COALESCE(SUM(ph.point_amount), 0) AS savedPoint, COALESCE(MAX(pw.total_point), 0) AS totalPoint, DATE_FORMAT(p.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS completedAt FROM payment p JOIN user_card uc ON p.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id JOIN card cd ON uc.card_id = cd.card_id LEFT JOIN point_history ph ON p.expense_id = ph.expense_id AND ph.member_id = p.member_id AND ph.point_type = 'SAVE' LEFT JOIN point_wallet pw ON ph.point_wallet_id = pw.point_wallet_id WHERE p.member_id = #{userId} AND p.payment_id = #{paymentId} GROUP BY p.payment_id, p.expense_id, cd.card_name, p.merchant_name, p.payment_amount, p.payment_status, p.completed_at
